mods.name: Reduced Elytra Firework
mods.description: Reduces the power and duration of fireworks when used to boost elytra (good for building too)

releases.notes:
Feature update bringing configurable firework power and speed, and mod requirement options for servers.
- Power and speed can be configurable through the `firework_power` and `firework_speed` gamerules
- Departure from vanilla acceleration function; firework acceleration decreases linearly until their max speed, after which it is 0
- Allow clients without Reduced Elytra Firework to join if the server owner chooses to do so through a JSON config file
- Fix issue making dedicated server usage not work
- (Hopefully) added a warning if strict enforcement is off and mismatched versions of Reduced Elytra Firework are present

Corresponding Modrinth release: https://modrinth.com/mod/reduced-elytra-firework/version/1.1.0

For Fabric 26.1.2, loader version 0.19.2.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/spsquared/elytra_firework_reduced/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

releases.notes:
First release, with firework power/duration reduction when used to boost elytra. Server will enforce all clients to install the mod and clients will disable changes when the server doesn't have Reduced Elytra Firework installed.

Corresponding Modrinth release: [https://modrinth.com/mod/reduced-elytra-firework/version/1.0.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/reduced-elytra-firework/version/1.0.0)

For Fabric 26.1.2, loader version 0.19.2.
